procurementChecks: Obtain current product-specific accessibility conformance report and confirm version/module scope.
Request current SOC 2 Type II / ISO certificates and verify legal entity, service boundary, audit period and exceptions.
Confirm production, backup, disaster-recovery, logs, telemetry, support and AI processing locations in contract/DPA.

researchTasks: Primary market also mentions audiences with no category yet: "Mid-market and enterprise; employee learning; customer and partner education".
Commercial relationship set to none; confirm before publication (affiliate programs in docs/affiliates.md).
Not re-checked by us: assurance findings are from the workbook research of 7 Nov 2026. Re-open each source before publishing.

Ask vendor (Trains AI models on customer data): Is customer data used to train, fine-tune, evaluate or improve foundation models or classifiers? Please distinguish opt-in, opt-out and default behaviour.

Ask vendor (How long prompts and chats are kept): How long are prompts, chats, uploaded files, generated outputs and logs retained? Please distinguish platform retention from model-provider retention.

Ask vendor (Who processes the data): Please provide the complete current list of AI model providers and subprocessors that process prompts, chats, uploaded files or generated outputs, including processing locations.
Ask vendor (AI models used): Please identify the current model names/version or state explicitly that models are proprietary/in-house or not disclosed. Please map models to AI features.
Ask vendor (Minimum learner age): What is the minimum learner age under your current terms, and what school/parental consent conditions apply?
Ask vendor (Staff can review AI output before learners see it): Can staff review AI-generated content before learners see it or before grades/feedback are released?
Ask vendor (Staff can set limits on the AI): Can administrators/educators set topic, prompt, feature, or access restrictions?
Ask vendor (Staff can see learner conversations): Can staff see learner conversations? Which roles can access them, and can this be disabled?
Ask vendor (How it responds to learners): Is the AI designed to coach learners with questions/hints, follow educator-defined behaviour, or provide direct answers? Can this be configured?
Ask vendor (Answers from your own course content): Can the AI answer from customer-provided course content or institutional knowledge? Can this be restricted to approved content?
Ask vendor (Shows its sources): Does the AI show citations or source references for answers grounded in uploaded/course content?
Ask vendor (Who owns what the AI produces): Who owns generated courses, questions, feedback, assessments and learner outputs? What licence does your company retain?
